title: Jazzy Nutty Turkish Lettuce Dumplings
description: An airy, nutty twist on Turkish manti, these lettuce dumplings celebrate a light, shattering crunch, perfect for a date-night spread. The dish is Ayurvedic Rajasic-friendly, paella-pan cooked to gentle perfection.
instructions: Wash the iceberg lettuce and shred it finely into a large bowl.
Add almond flour, ground flaxseed, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and pepper and stir until the mixture forms a cohesive dough-like consistency.
Drop teaspoon-sized portions of the mixture into a hot paella pan and press them together to form small dumplings, then slide the pan onto the stove.
Heat olive oil in the paella pan, then brown the dumplings on all sides for about 2 minutes per side.
Pour the vegetable broth into the pan, bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to a simmer and cover for 15 minutes.
Add chopped cashew nuts, stir, and cook for an additional 5 minutes so the nuts soften slightly.
Remove the pan from heat, sprinkle fresh dill over the dumplings, and let them rest for 2 minutes.
Serve the dumplings hot straight from the paella pan for a dramatic presentation.
